subject: Invoice enrichment / delivery preference — portal invite & PO ingestion
messages:
From: Marta Norris <marta.norris@acmehealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap-payments@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice fields + delivery — onboarding question

Hi Soojin,

We’re getting set up to receive invoices from Redwood for the new pilot. A couple quick questions from AP so we can route and pay without delays:

- Can you confirm the recommended invoice field set (PO number, line-level SKU, VAT/tax tags, remit-to entity)? Our ERP needs PO# and VAT on every invoice.
- AP prefers receiving invoices via a supplier portal (CSV/UBL push) long-term — but they need signed PDFs while the portal is being enabled. Is Redwood able to provide both (portal push + PDF copy) during the first month?
- If you support SFTP or an e-invoice webhook, what file schema should we expect?

Attaching the PO we’ll be using for the pilot.

Thanks — appreciate a quick check so we can confirm the billing contact and cadence.

Best,
Marta Norris
Senior Payables Analyst
Acme Health
[Attachment: PO-54321.pdf (pdf)]

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Norris <marta.norris@acmehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 10:04:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice fields + delivery — onboarding question

Hi Marta — thanks for the PO. Quick answers and a proposed path forward:

Short answer:
- Yes — we can provide both: a portal push (preferred) and a PDF copy to an email address during the enrollment window.

What we recommend (minimal required fields):
- Invoice header: invoice_number, invoice_date, due_date, currency, total_amount
- PO information: po_number (required), po_line_reference (optional)
- Tax/vat: vat_number (billing entity), tax_type (e.g., standard / reverse_charge), vat_amount or tax_breakdown per line
- Remit: remit_party_name, remit_address, remit_bank_iban (if pay-by-bank)

File transport options we support now:
- Portal push (preferred): signed UBL/PEPPOL or our JSON webhook (POST) — we’ll send a schema sample.
- SFTP drop: CSV/ZIP with a manifest.
- Email PDF copy: PDF attachment to ap-payments@acmehealth.com — used as temporary fallback.

I’ve attached a small invoice_fields_template.csv showing field names we can populate.

Operational notes:
- Enrollment timeline: Portal invite → test invoice (pdf + payload) → 2-week parallel period with email copies → cutover. We can keep parallel for 2 invoices by default.
- Mapping: If you send a sample invoice or tell us the ERP mapping for TaxType, we’ll align names (e.g., map your TaxType=RC to tax_type=reverse_charge).

Can you confirm: preferred transport (portal push or SFTP), preferred cadence (monthly/biweekly), and the AP user emails we should invite? I’ll loop in Kimberly to issue the portal invite and Ben for integration if SFTP/webhook is chosen.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[sent from mobile]
[Attachment: invoice_fields_template.csv (csv)]

From: Marta Norris <marta.norris@acmehealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap-payments@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2029 09:50:36 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice fields + delivery — onboarding question

Soojin — great, portal push is our preference. Details below:

- Preferred transport: Portal push (JSON webhook) with a PDF copy sent to ap-payments@acmehealth.com for the first two invoices while we validate.
- Cadence: Monthly (calendar month).
- AP invite list: ap-payments@acmehealth.com (this mailbox is monitored by our AP team).
- ERP notes: PO for the pilot = PO-54321 (attached). VAT number for the billing entity is GB999888777. If possible, map our TaxType=RC to tax_type=reverse_charge and include tax_breakdown at line level.

Please send the schema sample and a test webhook endpoint when available. Also confirm whether Redwood can include a machine-readable VAT field on invoices so our VAT reconciliation tools can auto-match.

Thanks — Marta
[Attachment: PO-54321.pdf (pdf)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

2) We’ll publish the JSON webhook schema to the shared HubSpot deal and provide a sample payload within 24 hours: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/4300/record/DEAL-4987

Kimberly Park
